triggers: a Metal kernel risks the 'writing b fragments via thread_elements() with a guessed layout produces wrong numerics' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on Apple M-series Metal: writing b fragments via thread_elements() with a guessed layout produces wrong numerics

problem.target: Apple Silicon (M-series) unified-memory GPU, Metal 4 toolchains
problem.statement: writing b fragments via thread_elements() with a guessed layout produces wrong numerics

payload.attempted: Materializing dequantized weights directly into simdgroup fragments using the two documented thread-element mappings ([t/4][(t%4)*2+{0,1}] and [(t%4)*2+{0,1}][t/4]); a read-back probe also returned zeros for every thread.
payload.lesson: Stage fragments through threadgroup memory with simdgroup_load/store and measure; treat thread_elements() as write-only-opaque on metal4 toolchains until Apple documents the layout.

established_fact.mechanism: The per-thread element mapping of simdgroup_matrix fragments is not stable API on this toolchain: thread_elements() read-back returns zeros and neither documented layout matches hardware placement, so register-side dequant cannot be verified cheaply.

payload.observed: Correctness failures on small/ragged/ungrouped shapes (max_abs 1.1-3.6) for both layouts.
payload.root_cause: The per-thread element mapping of simdgroup_matrix fragments is not stable API on this toolchain: thread_elements() read-back returns zeros and neither documented layout matches hardware placement, so register-side dequant cannot be verified cheaply.
